name: elements
description: React components for transactional emails, landing pages, invoices and PDFs: email-safe HTML, responsive web HTML, and print-ready PDF HTML from one component tree.

paragraphs: Write once in React. Render emails, web pages, and PDFs from the same component tree.

Unlayer Elements is an open-source React component library for transactional emails, email templates, landing pages, invoices, reports, documents, and PDFs. Build content once and render it across three output modes:
Elements is built and maintained by the team behind Unlayer, the content creation platform used by thousands of companies to power email, page, and document experiences inside their products.
features: Email → Outlook, Gmail, Yahoo, Apple Mail
Web → Responsive pages and embedded experiences
Document → Print-ready HTML for PDF generation
is documented and tested as table-based output for email clients: packages/react/README.md
The email document shell includes MSO conditionals and Office namespaces: packages/react/src/utils/document-layouts.ts

whatItDoes.text: Write once in React. Render emails, web pages, and PDFs from the same component tree.

requirements.text: The package is MIT-licensed, makes no network calls, requires no API key or account, and has no runtime dependency on Unlayer's platform. renderToHtml() runs entirely in your own process, and the output is plain, static HTML that you own outright.
